preamble: C. J. (Jeremy) Morse will be 80 on 10 December. Over the course of the Azed series, and the Ximenes series before that, he has established himself as the most brilliant and successful competitive clue writer of all, with a long string of outstanding clues to his credit, many of which have won prizes. To mark the occasion, the accompanying puzzle incorporates eight of CJM’s gems, all of them Azed prize-winners (seven firsts and one second), printed in italics. Competitors should submit with their solutions a normal cryptic clue to MORSE. NB The answer at 33 Across was the clue word set for a competition puzzle marking 30 years of the Azed series.
